title: Rice breeding and an overview of the EIRLSBN at the coordinating center, CRRI, Cuttack

passages.note: The row records the CR2539-1 / IET 20266 line in a 2007 IVT-L varietal trial, with Swarna and IR49830-7-1-2-3 in its pedigree. The subsequent release section confirms IR82809-237 was the same line.
Lists IR82809-237, CR2539-1 and IET 20266 as identifiers of the line that Odisha released in 2009 after three years of testing.
